ValidationRule.description: Require Engagement, Communication Close Method picklist values when Coach Outreach is Record Type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed: Customer Self-Resolved"), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed: Customer Unresponsive"), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed: Resolved") ), RecordTypeId = "012d00000021xGL", OR( ISBLANK( TEXT( Engagement__c )), ISBLANK( TEXT( Communication_Close_Method__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The following fields are required to close this case: Engagement, Communication Close Method.
